page.overview:
Who is Earth titan?

The earth titans were gargantuan primordial entities made of stone. The Titanstone Knuckles, one of the Vestiges of Divergence, were carved from the heartstone of one of these creatures.

The titan that attacked Vasselheim during the ascension of Vecna to godhood had a gargantuan stone body hundreds of feet tall, with four 150 feet wide arms. After Vecna's defeat by Vox Machina, the titan froze where it was standing and was incorporated into the city by its inhabitants, who began creating shops and homes within its body. Chains, pulleys, and resource elevators dangled down from the body, pulling materials and people up into it, and many gardens had been created within its nooks and shelves. Snowdrops grew alongside its legs.

While Ashton was communing with the spirit of the dead primordial, he had a vision of several mountains of different sizes rising under a purple sky, forming a sort of monolithic crown around him that he felt was looking at him. He heard their voices saying, "We are the rock and stone. We are this world. [...] We've always been. Everything is cyclical."

This was one of multiple earth primordials. In its final battle, this titan was slammed into the ground violently enough to create the Zenwick Mountains and left the titan in an upright position embedded into the mountains.
